a.xlink:title: Gives every body its minimum size on screen for a view of viewScale logical pixels per scene unit.
The name of a train in lists and messages: its operating code, or its description when it has none.
Sets the identifier of the train.
Sets how much the badge shows.
The train is selected or followed, which raises its badge over the others.
Keeps whether the train runs in the reversed direction.
Sets the speed of the train as text.
Sets whether the Detailed presentation shows the speed.
Keeps the description, the operating code and the type of the train. The badge shows no tooltip.
Sets the look of the train, which gives the icon.
A badge in the Overview presentation with the look of TrainVisualKind::Passenger.
A body with the shape of polygon and train index -1.
An empty group with train index -1 and no bodies.
The line of the preview that the track line with this index in the run is drawn on,...
The line of the preview with this track id in the scene, or null.
The id in the scene of the track line with this index in the run; empty when the run has none for it.
The zoom ratio from which a badge shows the speed.
The zoom ratio from which a badge is in the Identity presentation.
The badge shape of a kind: a capsule for an intercity, square for freight, rounded for the others.
The fill of a train without a service colour: RGB (235, 210, 55).
The outline of a train without a service colour: RGB (110, 90, 20).
How much the badge shows.
